task_claim.result_policy: strict boolean success at producer; no inferred outcome
task_claim.review_notes: Every return branch is pinned above; delegated command envelopes retain their producer success flag. Intermediate identity/bundle/session dictionaries are not command results: only their refusal paths propagate. Diagnostic reads report successful observation even when the observed resource is unhealthy. Mutation refusals and blocked effects report false; transport and executor never infer success from error keys. Frozen-main reconciliation (c29fcd7804cef4e96bc45f3a3502ae4e8d3e70cb): reviewed producer exits and original-principal resource gates; typed adapters retain their domain contracts. Generated handlers emit explicit booleans or retain delegated producer outcomes; generated invocation stays disabled.  Reviewed unified hierarchy admission and admission recheck after preparation verification; helpers retain their claim result envelopes, boolean success values, and original-principal resource gates. Fast-smooth completion merge: retain dev preparation-result and delivery-snapshot fences while using epic AdmissionView for shared hierarchical eligibility; helper return protocol remains unchanged. Hand-integration reconciliation: reviewed _attempt_claim_once independent-candidate first pass and full dependent fallback from b13bf05af/PR1845; both paths retain the existing boolean claim envelopes, source snapshot fences, original-principal gates and preparation ownership. No new return protocol. Missing-claim-marker recovery: reviewed marker write/readback before activation and the delegated _drain_missing_claim_session producer. Its stale-instance/epoch branch returns PREPARE_FAILED; confirmed current sessions go through ordinary pool teardown and return DRAIN_REQUESTED. Both retain _simple boolean claim envelopes and existing original-principal resource gates. Attached writer bindings remain owned by guarded teardown. Slot preparation queue allowance: reviewed configured reset budget plus the mutation allowance in _prepare_and_activate_locked; current-fence and expiry enforcement, lock ordering, claim envelopes and resource gates remain unchanged. Post-preparation rejection: reviewed bounded contention and admission comparison failures, epoch-fenced diagnostics, and guarded detach-or-retain before release. Repeated or retained rejections return PREPARE_FAILED; a first safely released admission change retains the fresh-selection retry. Delegated boolean claim envelopes and original-principal resource gates remain unchanged.
